analysis.title: The Point for Asia Pacific, Friday, 20 November 2026
key_insights: Alibaba FY2Q27 revenue rose 10% y/y to Rmb271.5bn, 1.3% above Citi's estimate and 0.4% above Bloomberg consensus. Non-GAAP net income to shareholders was Rmb20.0bn (+91.7% y/y), below Citi's Rmb26.4bn and consensus Rmb28.2bn, mainly on lower gross margin and higher tax.

Alibaba segment detail: E-commerce Group +2% y/y to Rmb197.2bn with customer management revenue -5% y/y to Rmb75.0bn. China quick-commerce +22% y/y to Rmb58.8bn (12.5% above Citi), international e-commerce -8% to Rmb25.7bn (4.5% below Citi), AI Cloud and Compute +53% y/y to Rmb61.0bn (0.7% above Citi), AI Labs and Applications +51% to Rmb4.44bn (11% above Citi).

Lenovo 2QFY26/27: ISG and SSG contributed 61% of the three business groups' operating profit, and IDG kept a 7.1% operating margin. Management cited an US$80bn AI server pipeline. Citi says the current valuation already discounts 50% of NeoCloud-linked ISG profits at zero value. Citi reiterates Buy with a new TP of HK$36.7.

JT announced deconsolidation of its Russia business effective Nov 1, 2026, a ¥1.37trn impairment, and a 25% cut to FY12/26 DPS to ¥204 from ¥272. It raised its operating profit growth outlook from high single digits to over 10% from FY12/27. Citi sees the news as largely within expectations.

Korea and China concluded follow-up FTA negotiations on Nov 18 after an 8-year hiatus. Citi sees a positive signal for lifting the 'Hallyu ban' but keeps a Neutral view on Korea Entertainment and Consumer. LG H&H, Amorepacific, PharmaResearch and Hotel Shilla are named as primary beneficiaries.

PDD 3Q26 revenue was flat y/y at Rmb108.3bn, short of expectations on weaker transaction services. Online marketing grew 12% y/y and earnings beat on lower opex and steady gross margin. Citi keeps Buy and raises TP to US$143 from US$136 on an unchanged 10x revised 2027E EPS.

India PSU banks 2QFY27: RoAs held. INBK and UNBK were the most consistent at 130-140 bps for nine quarters and SBI held at 1.1%. FCNR mobilization was modest at 1.5-2.5% of deposits, with BOB at 4.7%. BOI leads core advances growth. Citi prefers SBI among PSBs but favors private banks at the segment level.

South Korea: Citi estimates household equity capital loss of about KRW563trn in 2H26E. The cumulative impact on GDP, private consumption and CPI is -0.2ppt, -0.5ppt and -0.1ppt over 2H26-2027. Citi says this is comparable to a BOK 50-75bp rate hike. The BOK's own estimate for a 50bp hike is -0.12ppt on real GDP and -0.08ppt on CPI over one year.

Seatrium reported S$1.9bn of 9M26 order wins, mostly in 3Q26, and flagged a possible >S$2bn FLNG conversion project with Golar. The target pipeline is unchanged at S$32bn over 24 months against a S$12bn order book. Citi says the order replenishment concern is the key overhang and can only ease with significant new wins.

Sunway Construction 3Q26 core net profit was RM102m (+15% y/y, -3% q/q), within expectations. YTD new wins of RM9.8bn exceeded the RM7-9bn full-year guidance, and the order book is a record RM12.5bn. The tender book is RM15.7bn, over 80% from data centers. Maintain Buy, TP RM9.40.

PLDT: Citi opened a 30-day downside Catalyst Watch after MSCI moved it from the Philippine Standard Index to the MSCI Small Cap Index. Citi estimates more than 30 days of potential share outflow given limited liquidity. Rebalancing could begin as early as Nov 27, ahead of the Nov 30 MSCI deadline. The stock has a 9% yield and trades at 7x FY27E PER.

Rating and target price changes: Tencent TP cut to HK$629 from HK$755 (Buy), Futu TP to US$139 from US$157 (Buy/High risk), Zhaojin Mining TP to HK$32.00 from HK$41.40 (Buy), Vedanta TP to Rs210 from Rs235 (Sell), CDL Hospitality Trusts TP to S$0.58 from S$0.62 (Sell). Raised: JOYY to US$87 from US$83 and HUTCHMED to HK$45.30 from HK$43.20.

sector_views.rationale: The Korea-China FTA is a strong positive signal for lifting the Hallyu ban, and large-scale concerts could drive a re-rating. Cosmetics, medical aesthetics and duty-free shopping are seen as positive.
Citi prefers SBI among PSBs, but its segment bias favors private banks. Asset quality is benign and RoAs are resilient.
Data center projects drive record order wins. More than 80% of the RM15.7bn tender book comes from data centers.

earnings_insights: Alibaba FY2Q27 (reported): revenue Rmb271.5bn vs Citi estimate Rmb268.1bn and Bloomberg consensus Rmb270.5bn. Non-GAAP net income Rmb20.0bn vs Citi estimate Rmb26.4bn and consensus Rmb28.2bn. Non-GAAP EPADS Rmb8.10 vs Citi estimate Rmb10.97 and consensus Rmb10.75.

PDD 3Q26 (reported): revenue Rmb108.3bn, flat y/y and below expectations. Online marketing grew 12% y/y. Earnings beat expectations on lower opex and steady gross margin. Citi's new forecasts: FY27E non-GAAP net profit US$5,001m (+10% vs old), FY27E non-GAAP diluted EPS US$ 35.0 cents (+11%).
Lenovo 2QFY26/27 (reported): IDG operating margin 7.1%. ISG and SSG were 61% of the three groups' operating profit. AI server pipeline US$80bn, with Enterprise and SMB clients up 200% y/y.
JT FY12/26: DPS cut to ¥204 from ¥272 (-25%), with a ¥1.37trn impairment. Citi's yield-based support level is derived from 4% yield on FY12/26CE DPS of ¥204.
Sunway Construction 3Q26 (reported): core net profit RM102m, +15% y/y and -3% q/q, within Citi's expectations. Citi expects a stronger 4Q26 on backloaded revenue recognition.
Seatrium 9M26 (reported): order wins S$1.9bn, order book S$12bn, target pipeline S$32bn on a 24-month rolling basis.

Citi's revised Chinese e-commerce estimates (RMB mn, issuer not named in the extract): 2026E net revenues 456,807 (-2.5% vs old), non-GAAP net profit 109,532 (+4.6%), non-GAAP diluted EPADS RMB74.21 (+4.6%). 2027E revenue 499,006 (-3.2%), net profit 142,179 (+3.8%), EPADS 95.91 (+3.8%).

macro_indicators.indicator: BOK policy rate hike equivalent of household equity wealth loss
macro_indicators.interpretation: Citi estimates the wealth effect from household equity losses would drag growth and inflation as much as a 50-75bp BOK hike, which weighs on the case for BOK tightening.

macro_indicators.indicator: BOK estimate of 50bp hike impact on real GDP growth
macro_indicators.interpretation: The BOK's own estimate of the cumulative GDP drag from a 50bp hike, used as the benchmark for Citi's wealth-effect comparison.

macro_indicators.indicator: BOK estimate of 50bp hike impact on CPI inflation
macro_indicators.interpretation: The BOK's own estimate of the cumulative CPI drag from a 50bp hike.
Citi estimates a large household equity loss in 2H26, against gains of KRW579trn in 1H26 and KRW429trn in 2025.

macro_indicators.indicator: Impact of 2H26 household equity loss on Korean GDP, private consumption and CPI
macro_indicators.interpretation: Cumulative drag on annual GDP, private consumption and CPI from the negative wealth effect.

trade_ideas.description: Downside Catalyst Watch on PLDT (TEL.PS), 30 days, on MSCI index deletion flows
trade_ideas.rationale: Index tracking funds and ETFs must rebalance after the downgrade to the MSCI Small Cap Index, and PLDT's liquidity is limited.
trade_ideas.risk: Over the medium term interest may revive as fundamentals return after the initial sell-down.

risk_factors: Alibaba: lower gross margin and higher tax pushed non-GAAP net profit below estimates, and international e-commerce and customer management revenue declined.
Lenovo: PC shipment pressure and a higher AI server mix weigh on margins, and NeoCloud client risk is a concern. Citi cites cash-flow discipline, prepayments and third-party financing as mitigants.
Seatrium: order book replenishment against a S$12bn order book, with FID timing controlled by customers.
India PSU banks: credit cost normalization, ECL transition, diminishing treasury and recoveries support, and below-system growth threaten RoA sustenance.
PLDT: forced index selling from the MSCI deletion with limited liquidity.
vol_and_positioning: PLDT: Citi expects significant short-term outbound flows from MSCI-tracking funds and ETFs after its move to the MSCI Small Cap Index. It estimates more than 30 days of potential share outflow given limited liquidity. Rebalancing may start as early as Nov 27 ahead of the Nov 30 MSCI deadline.
geopolitical: Korea and China concluded follow-up FTA negotiations on Nov 18 after an 8-year hiatus, a possible end to the decade-long Hallyu ban on Korean entertainment content in China.
JT deconsolidated its Russia business effective Nov 1, 2026, booking a ¥1.37trn impairment.
PDD faces a tariff issue in Europe, per the report headline 'Navigating Tariff In Europe'.

tension_points.bull_case: RoAs are resilient, with INBK and UNBK at 130-140 bps for nine quarters and SBI at 1.1%. Asset quality is benign, with credit cost well below the cyclical average, and PSBs have surprised positively on earnings.
tension_points.bear_case: RoA sustenance is at risk from credit cost normalization, the ECL transition, diminishing treasury and recoveries support, and below-system growth.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Credit cost normalizing from well below the cyclical average, together with fading treasury and recoveries support.

tension_points.bull_case: Cash-flow discipline, prepayment requirements and third-party financing mitigate NeoCloud client risk. Valuation already discounts 50% of NeoCloud-linked ISG profits with zero assigned value.
tension_points.bear_case: NeoCloud client risk and PC shipment pressure alongside a higher AI server mix could pressure margins.
